A sweet shop has 396 laddus, 540 barfis and 612 pedas. It packs them into boxes so that every box has the same number of sweets, each box holds only one kind of sweet, and the number per box is as large as possible. Find the number of sweets in each box and the total number of boxes needed.

For the school Annual Day march past, the NCC wing has 72 cadets, the Scouts wing has 108 students and the Band wing has 144 students. The coordinator wants to arrange all students in rows so that every row has the same number of students and each row contains students of one wing only.
(i) Express 72 and 108 as products of prime factors. [1]
(ii) Find the HCF of 72, 108 and 144. [1]
(iii) Find the maximum number of students that can stand in each row and the total number of rows formed. [2]
OR
(iii) The three wings start a drill routine whose cycles last 72, 108 and 144 seconds respectively, all starting together. After how many seconds do they all start a cycle together again? [2]
